verses.t: Woe to those who give less [than due]
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the defrauders
verses.yusufAli: Woe to those that deal in fraud
verses.rodwell: Woe to those who STINT the measure
verses.sale: Woe be unto those who give short measure or weight

verses.t: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full
verses.pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full
verses.yusufAli: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure
verses.rodwell: Who when they take by measure from others, exact the full
verses.sale: who, when they receive by measure from other men, take the full

verses.t: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss
verses.pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss
verses.yusufAli: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due
verses.rodwell: But when they mete to them or weigh to them, minish
verses.sale: but when they measure unto them, or weigh unto them, defraud

verses.t: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verses.pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
verses.yusufAli: Do they not think that they will be called to account
verses.rodwell: What! have they no thought that they shall be raised again
verses.sale: Do not these think they shall be raised again

verses.t: For a tremendous Day
verses.pickthall: Unto an Awful Day
verses.yusufAli: On a Mighty Day
verses.rodwell: For the great day
verses.sale: at the great day

verses.t: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds
verses.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds
verses.yusufAli: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds
verses.rodwell: The day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds
verses.sale: the day whereon mankind shall stand before the Lord of all creatures

verses.t: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen
verses.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin
verses.yusufAli: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin
verses.rodwell: Yes! the register of the wicked is in Sidjin
verses.sale: By no means. Verily the register of the actions of the wicked is surely in Sejjin

verses.t: And what can make you know what is sijjeen
verses.pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is
verses.rodwell: And who shall make thee understand what Sidjin is
verses.sale: And what shall make thee to understand what Sejjin is

verses.t: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.pickthall: A written record
verses.yusufAli: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed
verses.rodwell: It is a book distinctly written
verses.sale: It is a book distinctly written

verses.t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
verses.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day
verses.yusufAli: Woe, that Day, to those that deny
verses.rodwell: Woe, on that day, to those who treated our signs as lies
verses.sale: Woe be, on that day, unto those who accused the prophets of imposture

verses.t: Who deny the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
verses.yusufAli: Those that deny the Day of Judgment
verses.rodwell: Who treated the day of judgment as a lie
verses.sale: who denied the day of judgment as a falsehood

verses.t: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor
verses.pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor
verses.yusufAli: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner
verses.rodwell: None treat it as a lie, save the transgressor, the criminal
verses.sale: And none denieth the same as falsehood, except every unjust and flagitious person

verses.t: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
verses.pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old
verses.yusufAli: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients
verses.rodwell: Who, when our signs are rehearsed to him, saith, "Tales of the Ancients
verses.sale: Who, when our signs are rehearsed unto him, saith, they are fables of the ancients

verses.t: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning
verses.pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts
verses.yusufAli: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do
verses.rodwell: Yes; but their own works have got the mastery over their hearts
verses.sale: By no means: But rather their lusts have cast a veil over their hearts

verses.t: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned
verses.pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord
verses.yusufAli: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled
verses.rodwell: Yes; they shall be shut out as by a veil from their Lord on that day
verses.sale: By no means. Verily they shall be shut out from their Lord on that day

verses.t: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire
verses.pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell
verses.yusufAli: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell
verses.rodwell: Then shall they be burned in Hell-fire
verses.sale: and they shall be sent into hell to be burned

verses.t: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny
verses.pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny
verses.yusufAli: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false
verses.rodwell: Then shall it be said to them, "This is what ye deemed a lie
verses.sale: Then shall it be said unto them, by the infernal guards, this is what ye denied as a falsehood

verses.t: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun
verses.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin
verses.yusufAli: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin
verses.rodwell: Even so. But the register of the righteous is in Illiyoun
verses.sale: Assuredly. But the register of the actions of the righteous is in Illiyyun

verses.t: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is
verses.rodwell: And who shall make thee understand what Illiyoun is
verses.sale: And what shall cause thee to understand what Illiyyun is

verses.t: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.pickthall: A written record
verses.yusufAli: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed
verses.rodwell: A book distinctly written
verses.sale: It is a book distinctly written

verses.t: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)
verses.yusufAli: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah)
verses.rodwell: The angels who draw nigh unto God attest it
verses.sale: Those who approach near unto God, are witnesses thereto

verses.t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight
verses.yusufAli: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss
verses.rodwell: Surely, among delights shall the righteous dwell
verses.sale: Verily the righteous shall dwell among delights

verses.t: On adorned couches, observing
verses.pickthall: On couches, gazing
verses.yusufAli: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things)
verses.rodwell: Seated on bridal couches they will gaze around
verses.sale: Seated on couches they shall behold objects of pleasure

verses.t: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight
verses.yusufAli: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss
verses.rodwell: Thou shalt mark in their faces the brightness of delight
verses.sale: thou shalt see in their faces the brightness of joy

verses.t: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed
verses.pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed
verses.yusufAli: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed
verses.rodwell: Choice sealed wine shall be given them to quaff
verses.sale: They shall be given to drink of pure wine, sealed

verses.t: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete
verses.pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss
verses.yusufAli: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations
verses.rodwell: The seal of musk. For this let those pant who pant for bliss
verses.sale: the seal whereof shall be musk: And to this let those aspire, who aspire to happiness

verses.t: And its mixture is of Tasneem
verses.pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim
verses.yusufAli: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim
verses.rodwell: Mingled therewith shall be the waters of Tasnim
verses.sale: And the water mixed therewith shall be of Tasnim

verses.t: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink
verses.pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink
verses.yusufAli: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah
verses.rodwell: Fount whereof they who draw nigh to God shall drink
verses.sale: a fountain whereof those shall drink who approach near unto the divine presence

verses.t: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed
verses.pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed
verses.yusufAli: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed
verses.rodwell: The sinners indeed laugh the faithful to scorn
verses.sale: They who act wickedly laugh the true believers to scorn

verses.t: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances
verses.pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them
verses.yusufAli: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery)
verses.rodwell: And when they pass by them they wink at one another
verses.sale: and when they pass by them, they wink at one another

verses.t: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting
verses.pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting
verses.yusufAli: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting
verses.rodwell: And when they return to their own people, they return jesting
verses.sale: And when they turn aside to their people, they turn aside making scurrilous jests

verses.t: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost
verses.pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray
verses.yusufAli: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray
verses.rodwell: And when they see them they say, "These are the erring ones
verses.sale: And when they see them, they say, verily these are mistaken men

verses.t: But they had not been sent as guardians over them
verses.pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them
verses.yusufAli: But they had not been sent as keepers over them
verses.rodwell: And yet they have no mission to be their guardians
verses.sale: But they are not sent to be keepers over them

verses.t: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers
verses.pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers
verses.yusufAli: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers
verses.rodwell: Therefore, on that day the faithful shall laugh the infidels to scorn
verses.sale: Wherefore one day the true believers, in their turn, shall laugh the infidels to scorn

verses.t: On adorned couches, observing
verses.pickthall: On high couches, gazing
verses.yusufAli: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things)
verses.rodwell: As reclining on bridal couches they behold them
verses.sale: Lying on couches they shall look down upon them in hell

verses.t: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do
verses.pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do
verses.yusufAli: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did
verses.rodwell: Shall not the infidels be recompensed according to their works
verses.sale: Shall not the infidels be rewarded for that which they have done
